import os
import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
print("Loading datasets...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns in train: {list(train_df.columns)}")

# Extract features
comment_text = [x.lower() for x in train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")]
ids = train_df["id"].tolist()

# Hold-out validation split
val_size = 0.15
train_subset, val_subset = train_test_split(
    train_df,
    test_size=val_size,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df[
        ["identity_hate", "insult", "obscene", "severe_toxic", "threat", "toxic"]
    ].stack(),
)

# Extract features for subsets
train_text = [x.lower() for x in train_subset["comment_text"].fillna("")]
val_text = [x.lower() for x in val_subset["comment_text"].fillna("")]
test_text = [x.lower() for x in test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")]

# Prepare target matrix
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
X_train = np.array(train_text)
X_val = np.array(val_text)
X_test = np.array(test_text)

y_train_full = train_subset[label_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_val = val_subset[label_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Vectorize
print("Vectorizing text with TF-IDF...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=30000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, max_df=0.95)
X_train_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = tfidf.transform(X_test)

print(f"Feature matrix shape (train): {X_train_vec.shape}")
print(f"Feature matrix shape (val): {X_val_vec.shape}")

# Train models for each label
models = {}
auc_scores = {}

for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    print(f"\nTraining model for {col}...")

    X_tr = X_train_vec[i] if X_train_vec.shape[1] > 1 else X_train_vec
    y_tr = y_train_full[:, i]

    # Convert sparse to dense for LGBM
    X_tr_dense = X_tr.toarray().astype(np.float32)
    X_val_dense = (
        X_val_vec[i].toarray().astype(np.float32)
        if hasattr(X_val_vec[i], "toarray")
        else X_val_vec[i].toarray().astype(np.float32)
    )

    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "force_col_wise": True,
        "first_metric_only": True,
    }

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_dense, label=y_tr)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_dense, label=y_val[:, i], reference=train_data)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=300,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
    )

    models[col] = model

    # Calculate validation AUC
    proba = model.predict(X_val_dense)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], proba)
    auc_scores[col] = auc
    print(f"{col} validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Calculate mean column-wise ROC AUC
mean_auc = np.mean(list(auc_scores.values()))
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"MEAN COLUMN-WISE ROC AUC ON HOLD-OUT VALIDATION: {mean_auc:.6f}")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print("\nIndividual AUC scores:")
for col, score in auc_scores.items():
    print(f"  {col}: {score:.6f}")

# Generate submission
print("\nGenerating submission...")
submissions = []
for col in label_cols:
    proba = models[col].predict(X_test)
    submissions.append(proba.flatten())

submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"]}, columns=["id"] + label_cols)
submission_df[label_cols] = submissions

# Save submission
output_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path}")

# Verify submission format
print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission_df)}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(submission_df.columns)}")
print(f"Shape match with sample: {submission_df.shape == sample_submission.shape}")
